newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht eases, players take wait-and-see stance.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht eases, players take wait-and-see stance.

text.p: Thai baht was steady to slightly lower early on Friday in a thin domestic market as most players took a wait-and-see stance ahead of a comprehensive economic package due to be announced soon, dealers said.
The baht moved in tight band of 31.950-32.350 baht per dollar early. The baht plunged to a record low level of 32.70 baht per dollar early on Thursday before firming to 31.950/32.020 late in the day.
The central bank on Friday announced a reference rate of 32.236 per dollar against 32.108 on Thursday.
